properties.summary: Reported to be diamagnetic in the solid state; no numerical magnetic measurement is given.

source_locations.location: Results and Discussion, compound 1 and Figure 1

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Eight Yb-containing dipyrrolyl units form a discrete dianionic macrocycle. Each dipyrrolide bridges adjacent Yb centers through pyrrolyl π- and σ-coordination. Two chlorides each bridge three Yb centers at opposite ends of the cavity. Two THF-solvated lithium counterions occupy the interstitial space without connecting to the cluster.

synthesis.procedure: Under Ar, MeLi in diethyl ether was added to diphenyldipyrromethane in THF at room temperature. After 15 min, YbCl3(THF)3 was added and the suspension stirred for 24 h. Excess lithium metal was then added; stirring continued for 16 h to give a dark-red mixture.
synthesis.temperature: Room temperature; gently heated before hot filtration
synthesis.time: 15 min before Yb addition; 24 h after Yb addition; 16 h after Li addition; 48 h crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Solution reaction under Ar followed by lithium-metal reduction
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: The mixture was gently heated to dissolve accumulated red solid and filtered hot to remove unreacted lithium. The solution was concentrated to 100 mL and layered with 15 mL hexanes; dark-red blocks separated after 48 h at room temperature.

properties.summary: Reported to be diamagnetic; no numerical magnetic measurement is given.

source_locations.location: Results and Discussion, compound 2 and Figure 2

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A single Yb center is π-bonded to one pyrrole ring from each of two ligands in a bent-ytterbocene arrangement. The other pyrrole ring of each ligand is σ-bonded to Yb and π-coordinated to a sodium center. Each sodium also binds two THF molecules and a pyrrole nitrogen.

synthesis.procedure: Diphenyldipyrromethane in anhydrous THF was treated with NaH and stirred for 1 h. YbCl3(THF)3 was added and the pale-yellow suspension stirred for 16 h. After filtration, finely dispersed sodium metal was added; vigorous stirring continued for 16 h.
synthesis.time: 1 h after NaH addition; 16 h after Yb addition; 16 h after sodium-metal addition; 2 days crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Solution reaction followed by reduction with finely dispersed sodium metal
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: The initial suspension was filtered before sodium-metal addition. After reduction, it was filtered again; the deep-red filtrate was concentrated to 25 mL, layered with 25 mL hexanes, and left at room temperature for 2 days to yield dark-red plates.

title: Monomeric and Octameric Divalent Ytterbium Complexes of Diphenylmethyl Dipyrrolyl Dianion
